	
Overview

This document describes how the automatic validation is implemented in UNICASE and how new validation rules in Java as well as in OCL can be defined. Validation is the automatic verification of model constraints. For the implementation of validation in UNICASE, the Eclipse Modeling Framework (EMF) Validation Framework (http://www.eclipse.org/modeling/emf/?project=validation) was used. The framework supports the definition of validation rules of the house from Java and OCL. In addition, other validation language can be integrated. Validation can take place both on static and dynamic way, i.e. as a batch job or live. This means that the validation is triggered either by the user, or continuously executed.
